ROOT_CAUSE: Git refs cannot simultaneously contain refs/heads/NEXY.AI-Test-AI as a branch and refs/heads/NEXY.AI-Test-AI/work/... as descendants. The required prefix is structurally incompatible with the existing integration branch name.
SCOPE_FREEZE: Source mutation requiring a V7-compliant worker branch.
ALTERNATIVES_REQUIRING_POLICY_CHANGE: Rename integration branch and preserve current branch as protected historical ref
SUPERSESSION_REASON: The incident proves the literal legacy worker prefix is impossible, but V16-RC1.3 no longer mandates that literal prefix. Isolation and no-direct-integration rules remain mandatory.
